verdict.rationale: Qapita's own marketing says the cap table gives investors a real-time view of ownership and serves as a single source of truth for founders, investors, and employees. That suggests investor-facing access to holdings. The 'investor portal' with performance reports appears to belong to its VC/PE fund-administration offering rather than the startup cap table, so structured founder-to-investor updates are not clearly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a startup investor portal with per-investor holdings views, a structured investor-updates feature for founders, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, my investors get their own portal view of their holdings and can receive structured updates without emailing me for the cap table
